jobs.title: Director, Product Design
jobs.description: Mission Axonius is at a pivotal moment. Our platform is a powerhouse of data and technology, and we're ready to move from being "tech-centric" to "user-centric." As the Director of Product Design, you aren't here to tweak a few buttons—you're here to transform an entire experience across a complex, multi-product platform. You will build and lead a full design department, owning the end-to-end user experience across all Axonius products. You'll be the connective tissue between product lines—synthesizing a coherent, intuitive experience from a sophisticated set of capabilities. And you'll be the person who defines what great UX looks like in the AI era: not just adapting to AI features, but rethinking how users interact with intelligence-first products. Beyond the craft, you'll drive real operational change. You'll lead the adoption of AI-powered workflows—not just within the design team, but in close partnership with Engineering—finding ways to compress cycles, ship faster, and create outsized impact. You'll work directly with customers, field teams, PMs, and developers, and you'll lead cross-functional processes that connect design to the business. Minimum Qualifications Leadership & Team Building: 4+ years leading a design team ; experience building and scaling a full design department, not just managing individuals. Platform-Scale Thinking: Proven ability to own the UX of a complex, multi-product platform end-to-end—connecting dots across product lines and creating a coherent whole. SaaS Expertise: Significant experience designing and shipping B2B SaaS products at scale. Product Overhaul Experience: Demonstrated success transforming a technical, complex product into an intuitive, high-end user experience. Stakeholder Management: Ability to advocate for design-led thinking at the executive level while collaborating effectively with Engineering, Sales, and field teams. People Development: A track record of mentoring designers and managing career growth, not just task delivery. Preferred Qualifications AI-Era UX: Experience designing for AI-powered products or defining UX patterns for intelligence-first experiences. AI Workflow Leadership: Hands-on experience driving AI adoption in design and development workflows—reducing cycle times, accelerating delivery, and enabling teams to do more with less. Cybersecurity Domain: Familiarity with cybersecurity or high-complexity data products. Design Systems: Deep expertise building and maintaining Design Systems that scale across complex platforms. Cross-Functional Process Leadership: Experience leading initiatives that span design, engineering, product, and go-to-market teams. Startup Agility: Comfortable balancing craft and speed in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Why Axonius? Full Ownership: You'll lead a real design department—not a single team, but a function—with the mandate to define how the entire platform feels and evolves. AI at the Center: You'll have a front-row seat to defining what AI-native product design means in enterprise security—a genuinely new design challenge. Impact at Scale: You'll directly shape how thousands of the world's leading organizations interact with their security infrastructure. You will lead end-to-end research projects, collaborating directly with Product and Development teams to convert technical research into product features. This is a high-impact role where your research directly shapes how our customers manage, prioritize and secure their entire assets inventory. jobs.title: Senior Security Researcher
jobs.description: As a Senior Security Researcher for the Axonius Exposures team, you will conduct research into vulnerability detection, remediation, and prioritization to enhance our asset intelligence platform. You will lead end-to-end research projects, collaborating directly with Product and Development teams to convert technical research into product features. You will analyze large-scale security data, automate workflows, and prototype logic to address enterprise attack surfaces. This is a high-impact role where your research directly shapes how our customers identify and mitigate their most critical security gaps. Responsibilities Lead end-to-end security research projects focusing on vulnerability detection, risk prioritization, and exposure management logic. Utilize Python, SQL, and AI/LLM tools to build data analysis pipelines, automate threat research, and prototype research tools. Research and define remediation strategies, compensating controls, and configuration-based mitigations beyond standard patching. Partner weekly with Product and Engineering teams to transform technical research into production-ready product capabilities. Minimum Qualifications 4+ years of professional experience in security research, vulnerability analysis, or penetration testing. Practical understanding of security frameworks and metrics including CVSS, EPSS, and MITRE ATT&CK. Experience in exposure management, attack surface management (ASM), or enterprise risk prioritization. Operating within the Cybersecurity Customer Success organization, you will deliver strategic technical consulting on security data correlation, platform design, and deployment health. The team’s mission is to translate complex asset management and query data into actionable operational workflows, drive platform adoption, and secure high-value renewals. Build and execute complex automated enforcement workflows and custom scripts to solve operational pain points, such as automated ticketing and shadow cloud discovery. Conduct regular technical reviews and data correlation assessments (EDR, Vulnerability, IAM, Network) to demonstrate quantifiable ROI to director-level stakeholders. Proactively track operational deployment health, identify technical implementation blockers or leadership risks, and deploy remediation plans to ensure customer retention.
